title: Traffic Alert: World Trade Bridge Delays as System Outage Hits Export Operations
excerpt: A system outage affecting export operations across Mexico is causing significant backups and delays at the World Trade Bridge, and Laredo police are urging drivers to avoid westbound Loop 20 unless they are in a commercial motor vehicle.
content:
A system outage affecting export operations across Mexico is impacting traffic at the World Trade Bridge, and drivers should expect significant backups and delays.

The Laredo Police Department issued the traffic alert on Tuesday, November 25, warning of heavy delays along westbound Loop 20 heading into Mexico.

Motorists are urged to use caution, allow extra travel time, and avoid westbound Loop 20 if they are not traveling in a commercial motor vehicle.

Traffic control units are assisting in the area, and police said they will provide updates as more information becomes available.

Sources: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 25, 2026.
